one_line: Agent proposes weekly staff rota, stages changes, and leaves approval to manager.
what_it_does: A human manager and agent collaboratively review and approve a constrained weekly rota.
leverage_rationale: Structured rule-engine calls, staged assignments, consent and audit surfaces make the agent materially more reliable than UI-driving automation.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: agent proposes whole week but cannot commit; rule engine identifies rest breach; staged dashed assignments and before/after consent surface.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a coherent end-to-end scheduling product with coverage, breaches, cost, dark/light modes, and tool audit; frames show the rota UI and editing states, though text is small.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: repeated rota grid, detail panels, and apparent edit/confirmation states across frame sheets.
impact_rationale: Scheduling errors affect staffing, compliance, cost, and workers; the manager-facing approval model directly addresses a real operational need.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: fourteen staff/seven days, labor-rest rules, coverage, wage budget, and human approval.
creativity_rationale: Strong, memorable framing of a rota as a promise and a carefully bounded agent workflow with auditability.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT: agent gets no commit tool; explicit consent and tool-call records are central design elements.
usability_note: The workflow appears usable for managers, but the packet does not establish deployment depth or accessibility beyond the stated UI.
red_flags: Frame-sheet text is too small for detailed verification.
advance_reason: High-quality, safety-conscious agent collaboration around a consequential workflow.

one_line: Shared live city workspace where a person and agent discover, stage, lock, and repair a night out.
what_it_does: A map/timeline-based collaborative planner for real-time local events and changing availability.
leverage_rationale: The shared mutable model of a night—human taste plus agent search and repair—is difficult to reproduce reliably through generic UI automation.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: structured WebMCP results appear in the same interface; agent adapts to locks/rejections and repairs plans.
execution_rationale: The concept is unusually complete: live city map, visual timeline, staging, human controls, and adaptation are described coherently; frame evidence shows populated app states but is not fully legible.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: map/timeline-style product states and populated event interfaces across sheets.
impact_rationale: There is a clear, recurring need to discover and coordinate events across fragmented sources, especially under time and availability changes.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: Stockholm/San Francisco launch; events, venues, ticketing, calendars, and social sources.
creativity_rationale: A strong interaction model: the city is a shared workspace rather than an itinerary chatbot, with taste and agency separated cleanly.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT: explicitly rejects AI itinerary generation in favor of a live shared model.
usability_note: Visual browsing and staged plans fit the use case; availability, pricing, and context accuracy remain unverified in the packet.
red_flags: No public repo; frame text is small.
advance_reason: Distinctive collaborative planning concept with meaningful WebMCP state sharing.

one_line: Agent finds, holds, and books a dental consultation, with a one-time human approval gate.
what_it_does: A browser-native dental booking workflow that exposes availability and booking state to an agent and human.
leverage_rationale: Structured discovery, eligibility, holds, and confirmation state are safer and more reliable than an agent guessing forms, especially with an approval token.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: services/availability/holds/booking/status tools; human approval required before confirmation; shared calendar state.
execution_rationale: The central workflow is clearly specified and frame sheets show a dental booking UI across states, but only one gallery image and no transcript limit observed detail.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: landing/calendar/booking states visible across three sheets.
impact_rationale: Dental practices and patients have a concrete scheduling problem; reducing booking friction while preserving consent is credible value.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: confirmed lead appears in dental inbox; explicit approval boundary.
creativity_rationale: A practical, safety-aware application of WebMCP to a high-friction booking task, though the concept is familiar.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT: live site exposes callable tools and approval is testable.
usability_note: The flow is understandable; real-world calendar integrations and accessibility are listed as future work.
red_flags: No public repository; demo is a simulation/live site claim.
advance_reason: Solid concrete booking workflow with clear human control.

one_line: Investigates a broken contractual promise, prepares an enforcement action, and files only after authorization.
what_it_does: Browser-native contract enforcement simulation from clause lookup through entitlement, notice, filing, and receipt.
leverage_rationale: Structured clause, penalty, notice, and filing tools create a reliable shared state and explicit authority boundary for consequential action.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: Contract → Entitlement → Approval → Action → Receipt; filing requires human authorization and proof hash.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a complete workflow and the frame sheets show multiple application states, though detailed text is not legible.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: contract/claim/action/receipt-style UI progression visible across sheets.
impact_rationale: Contract breaches and recovery are real, costly, and laborious; the product targets a specific high-value audience without requiring mass adoption.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: unpaid invoice, principal at stake, clause verification, remedy preparation.
creativity_rationale: The concept turns contract interpretation into bounded action while preserving human authority, a memorable and ambitious agent interaction.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT: explicit stop before notice generation and filing; proof-backed simulated filing.
usability_note: Strong staged workflow; legal jurisdiction, evidence quality, and simulation limits constrain practical usability.
red_flags: Simulation rather than real enforcement; frame text is small.
advance_reason: One of the strongest concepts: consequential automation with a clear authorization boundary.

one_line: Agent coordinates flight recovery, hotels, transport, notifications, budget, and itinerary after cancellation.
what_it_does: A stateful multi-provider travel-recovery planner exposing 12 WebMCP tools to ChatGPT’s browser.
leverage_rationale: Multi-step coordination across reservations and constraints is exactly where structured tools outperform UI driving; shared state and confirmation gates are central.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: 12 tools for flights, constraints, holds, hotels, transport, notifications, cost, itinerary; human confirms consequential actions.
execution_rationale: The stated workflow is broad and coherent, and frame sheets show travel recovery screens and populated results; lack of transcript reduces observation confidence.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: travel recovery UI, flight/hotel/transport-like states, and result screens across sheets.
impact_rationale: Flight cancellation before a fixed trip is a high-stakes, time-sensitive problem with clear value for travelers and support teams.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: canceled Miami flight before cruise; balances timing, hotel, transport, and budget.
creativity_rationale: Ambitious, memorable use of WebMCP as a direct capability surface for a complex recovery graph.
creativity_evidence: PITCH/ABOUT: no custom agent; ChatGPT discovers and calls site tools directly.
usability_note: The multi-step flow is compelling; real supplier integrations and transactional reliability are not established.
red_flags: Public repo; external transactional claims appear simulated or demo-scoped.
advance_reason: High leverage and impact through stateful orchestration, with strong ambition.

one_line: Local confidential-PDF workspace lets an agent search without reading documents until a human releases pages.
what_it_does: A privacy-preserving evidence workspace for confidential document retrieval and human-approved reading.
leverage_rationale: The key capability—agent retrieval over local confidential documents while withholding page content until approval—cannot be replicated comparably by generic UI driving without undermining the privacy model.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: PDFs parsed in browser and never uploaded; agent can search but cannot read a page before explicit release.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a coherent search→approval→reading workflow; frame sheets show an input-to-results workspace, though labels and tool calls are not legible.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: document/search workspace transitions from initial form to populated results.
impact_rationale: Security, procurement, legal, and compliance teams have a concrete need to search NDA-bound document sets without cloud upload.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: SOC 2, DPAs, pricing annexes, and questionnaires under NDA.
creativity_rationale: The privacy boundary is novel and deeply tied to the interaction model: the agent finds what it cannot read, with human evidence release.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT/PITCH: confidential PDFs, no page read without approval.
usability_note: Local parsing and approval affordances are promising; security guarantees and document-scale robustness need validation.
red_flags: Frame sheets are low resolution; no direct security audit evidence.
advance_reason: Exceptional concept and leverage for a real high-stakes document workflow.

one_line: No-sign-up invoice generator whose 17 WebMCP tools let an agent answer fit/pricing questions and create a real invoice.
what_it_does: An agent-first marketing/generator site that serves unauthenticated visitors and produces invoices.
leverage_rationale: For a visitor with no account, structured capability discovery and direct generation materially reduce ambiguity and form friction, though a competent agent could automate a conventional form with effort.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: 17 tools cover fit, pricing, invoice/proposal generation; demo corrects stale recommendation and makes invoice without sign-up.
execution_rationale: The product scope is focused and the described demo shows discovery, correction, and invoice generation; frame sheets show marketing/generator states and result views.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: agent/browser plus generator page and invoice-like output states visible across sheets.
impact_rationale: Small service businesses have a clear need for quick invoices without account setup; the no-sign-up promise directly serves that audience.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: free invoice tool for visitors and small service businesses.
creativity_rationale: The self-correcting agent/site interaction and agent-first marketing angle are a sharp, original application of WebMCP.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT: agent updates its answer from stale web understanding after inspecting live tools.
usability_note: Likely easy for visitors; real invoice validity and downstream accounting workflows are not evidenced.
red_flags: Public repo; frame details are small.
advance_reason: Clear demoable value with a distinctive capability-discovery story.

one_line: Shared build-vs-buy decision canvas where humans and agents change weights, simulate future stress, and log reranking.
what_it_does: A transparent decision model with agent tools, human overrides, and an auditable call log.
leverage_rationale: Structured tools mutate a shared decision model and expose reranking/overrides; generic UI driving could do it but with substantially less reliable state and auditability.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: nine tools, shared weights/future stress/overrides, every call logged; rerank must appear when state changes.
execution_rationale: The stated demo walk covers baseline, stress simulation, human pinning, and liability output; frame sheets show canvas/log/result states.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: decision canvas, cards, weights, future-stress and log-like states visible across sheets.
impact_rationale: Teams and individual builders repeatedly face build-vs-buy decisions; transparent assumptions and liability make the output more useful than prose.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: prototype/auth/scraping/HIPAA/50k-user scenarios and explicit non-financial-advice framing.
creativity_rationale: The insistence that the page visibly moves and the log proves reranking is a strong, original interaction contract.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT: if log did not change, it guessed; human override shows gap and liability list.
usability_note: The canvas is understandable and inspectable; estimates are demo numbers and not vendor-backed.
red_flags: Frame text is too small for detailed verification; estimates are explicitly simulated.
advance_reason: Strong transparent decision-support pattern with meaningful agent-state integration.

one_line: Real-time wildfire simulation and decision-support map where AI analyzes scenarios and humans approve plans.
what_it_does: An operational wildfire simulation, planning, and resource-coordination workspace with staged reversible actions.
leverage_rationale: Structured situation inspection, simulation, comparison, and staged commit/revert are a major reliability gain over UI driving for complex incident state.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: 21 tools inspect situation, list resources, simulate, compare, prepare, commit with approval, and revert.
execution_rationale: The product scope is substantial and coherent; frame sheets visibly show a 3D/map simulation, controls, and operational states, but not all end-to-end transitions.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: map/simulation views, resource overlays, and plan/action states across sheets.
impact_rationale: Incident commanders and response teams have an urgent, concrete need for scenario comparison and coordinated resource planning.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: fire progression, weather, units, threatened areas, evacuation and response strategies.
creativity_rationale: The combination of real-time simulation, multi-agent operational state, and reversible human-approved plans is ambitious and memorable.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT: staged-plan model; AI cannot directly commit; commit_plan/revert_plan.
usability_note: High information density and the complexity of local simulation may make onboarding difficult, but the workflow is purpose-fit.
red_flags: Operational accuracy and real-world validation are not evidenced; demo scope may be simulated.
advance_reason: Strong impact and ambition, with the right safety boundary for consequential planning.

one_line: Research workbench where agent gathers and synthesizes sources while humans accept evidence and approve the final brief.
what_it_does: A human-agent research cycle with provenance, evidence curation, synthesis, review, and Markdown export.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP gives the agent structured access to workspace state and research tools while preserving a human-controlled evidence set; generic browsing cannot guarantee the same provenance boundary.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT: human defines, agent researches, human curates, agent synthesizes, human approves; brief may cite only accepted evidence; activity readout records calls.
execution_rationale: The central workflow is unusually well specified and frame sheets show research-workbench states, evidence lists, and approval flow; fine text is not fully readable.
execution_evidence: VIDEO: research workspace, evidence/approval panels, and artifact-ready states across sheets.
impact_rationale: Researchers, analysts, and technical teams need fast evidence gathering with recency, authority, and provenance controls.
impact_evidence: ABOUT: OpenAlex sourcing, accepted evidence membership, approved Markdown artifact.
creativity_rationale: The explicit three-party interaction model and “what counts as evidence” boundary are original, ambitious, and deeply pursued.
creativity_evidence: PITCH/ABOUT: human-agent-website workbench; staged research cycle with human judgment.
usability_note: The staged workflow is clear and inspectable; source coverage and synthesis quality need ongoing human review.
red_flags: Frame sheets do not make exact tool names legible.
advance_reason: Excellent fit between WebMCP shared state and a high-value research workflow.
